findings.claim: get_monitor_environment_context() in incident_occurrence.py copies the monitor config and replaces schedule_type with its human-readable display value, but returns monitor_environment.monitor.config (the original, line 168) instead of the modified copy. The schedule_type transformation therefore never reaches the event context.

verifier.reason: In src/sentry/monitors/logic/incident_occurrence.py:160-162, get_monitor_environment_context() copies monitor_environment.monitor.config into local variable config and replaces config["schedule_type"] with get_schedule_type_display(), but line 168 returns "config": monitor_environment.monitor.config instead of config. Consequently, the modified copy is discarded and the raw integer schedule_type reaches event_data["contexts"]["monitor"] (line 85), as also reflected by the pre-existing assertion "schedule_type": 2 in tests/sentry/monitors/logic/test_mark_failed.py:114.
